title: THE FALSE PROTAGONIST
start: The world moved on without you. {rival} is already the region's rising star, and you are the one who lost.
npcLines: Wait… aren't you the one who lost?
I thought somebody else was supposed to save this region.
{rival} has already made their mark around here.
Some people just aren't meant to be the protagonist.
That Trainer is already several routes ahead of you.
Everyone's talking about {rival}. Nobody's talking about you.

rivalIntro.gymLeader: {rival}: "You finally decided to show up? I've already finished what we started. This Gym is mine now."
rivalIntro.finalist: {rival}: "Still chasing me? I'm already in the regional finals. Go home."
rivalIntro.champion: {rival}: "I'm the Champion now. This is where your story ended last time, remember?"

afterWin.gymLeader: {rival} can't believe it: the one who lost is catching up.
afterWin.finalist: {rival} stares at you: "How are you still here?"
afterWin.champion: The crowd goes quiet. The False Protagonist just beat the Champion.

outcomes.name: The Impossible Victory
outcomes.text: Against every odd, you beat {rival} at the very top. Nobody will forget it.

outcomes.name: The Usurper
outcomes.text: You beat {rival} and took their place as the region's Champion.

outcomes.name: The Catch-Up
outcomes.text: You finally caught up to {rival} and beat them.

outcomes.name: The Second Place
outcomes.text: You finished the journey, but never got past {rival}.

outcomes.name: The Forgotten
outcomes.text: You lost again, and {rival} is more famous than ever.
